description:
A simple and lightweight SQL client with cross database and platform support.

A simple and lightweight SQL client with cross database and platform support.
Note：Sqlectron no longer supports Windows 7.1, 8, 8.1 and macOS 10.11 and 10.12

## Features

• Update build/icon.icns to conform to Big Sur style by @amancevice in https://github.com/sqlectron/sqlectron/pull/682
• Allow user to select install location for Windows by @MasterOdin in https://github.com/sqlectron/sqlectron/pull/740
• Build arm64 dmg for macOS by @MasterOdin in https://github.com/sqlectron/sqlectron/commit/57378a33c7c418cd385ffb73e45586f67015d1e2
• Set up Windows code signing by @MasterOdin in https://github.com/sqlectron/sqlectron/commit/57378a33c7c418cd385ffb73e45586f67015d1e2 and https://github.com/sqlectron/sqlectron/pull/739
• Support ed25519 authentication for MariaDB by @MasterOdin in https://github.com/sqlectron/sqlectron/commit/f67761604d521078e72e0b8635d2aa4995d81322

## Bug Fixes

• Fix search crash Issue by @Ormax563 in https://github.com/sqlectron/sqlectron/pull/723
• Fix resizing server sidebar  by @ruddenchaux in https://github.com/sqlectron/sqlectron/pull/710
